title: Rig Relay WriteFile Receipt v1
description: Content-light receipt for a write_file invocation. Contains no raw file content — only metadata, SHA256 hashes, byte counts, path, and structured error classification.

error_kind.description: Structured error classification when status is not success

refusal_reason.description: Sanitized human-readable reason when status is refused or blocked

bytes_written.description: Number of bytes written to the file

before_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content before writing (null if file did not exist or hash was not captured)

after_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content after writing

before_bytes.description: File size in bytes before writing (null if file did not exist or size was not captured)

after_bytes.description: File size in bytes after writing (null if write did not succeed)

file_existed.description: Whether the file existed before the write operation

created_file.description: Whether this operation created a new file

overwrote_existing_file.description: Whether this operation overwrote an existing file

parent_dirs_created.description: Whether parent directories were created by this operation

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds (null if not measured)
